deploy-bot: [ALERT] canary deploy prompt-router-v6 at 20% failing 5xx (rate: 34%). trace=trb-8a3f
raj: paging @oncall — canary error spike, endpoint latencies >1s, started ~2026-03-17T09:02Z
oncall-bot: Paging mike (oncall) — urgent: canary error surge, channel #incidents
mike: I'm awake, looking. Any rollback already? What's the error class?
raj: 500s from prompt-router-v6: "kv cache miss NPE" in logs, stack snippet shows kernel mismatch; errors started after kernel rollforward
mike: Ok. Kill the feature flag for prompt-router-v6. I will flip to stable route. @deploy-bot, oncall for commands
deploy-bot: Accepted. Run flag toggle: ```curl -X POST https://control.redwood/flags/prompt_router_v6/toggle -H 'Authorization: Bearer ***' -d '{"state":"off"}'``` -> response 200
mike: toggled flag to OFF and reduced canary to 0% :thumbsup:
raj: watching metrics — 5xx back to baseline within 60s. latency back to normal. Good.
cs-rep-amy: CS: Notified customers that were affected (Acme Inc., BetaCorp, Gamma Labs) — opening incident tickets and drafting customer note; CS ticket #T-4532
mike: initiating rollback of the canary deployment to previous runtime image, start: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/prompt-router -n prod --to-revision=12`
deploy-bot: Rollback job started, rollout status: progressing
sre-lead-maria: taking over H1 handoff in 30m for postmortem and RCA. Please capture logs and repro steps. Also add mapping of model kernel->binary.
mike: logs archived to s3://redwood-incident-logs/1809991234/, trace ids: trb-8a3f,trb-8b1e
raj: thumbs up, closing active page after rollback stabilizes. If anything else pops up, ping @oncall
deploy-bot: Canary aborted; feature flag prompt_router_v6 OFF; rollback in progress; incident state: mitigated
mike: moving to monitoring window. I'll draft initial incident summary and notify eng leadership.
